subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw support a separate immutable official-plugin package/provenance root for self-hosted containers, and what proof should the runtime accept before granting trusted keyed-state access?
rationale: The source failure is clear, but the permanent fix decides a trusted-plugin state boundary and may add install/provenance/config surface across container deployments.

options.title: Design a portable official install root
options.body: Add a supported build-time official plugin install/provenance path outside mutable state mounts while keeping arbitrary load paths untrusted.

options.title: Keep current state-dir contract
options.body: Declare that runtime containers must mount the same complete OpenClaw state directory used at install time and close the deployment model as unsupported.

options.title: Trust explicit load paths
options.body: Allow operator-selected load paths or allowlists to access keyed state, accepting a broader spoofing/provenance risk.

recommendation.title: Design a portable official install root
recommendation.body: Add a supported build-time official plugin install/provenance path outside mutable state mounts while keeping arbitrary load paths untrusted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already provided the maintainer trust-model framing in the issue thread.
